services.name: Sport rental
services.desc: The North Shore Trail starts at the observation tower located adjacent to the Battlefords Goose Project. In the winter, a cross country ski trail can be accessed from Poundmaker Trail near the pedestrian bridge leading to Finlayson Island. The Trail System is available on Trailforks. The trail runs along the northern shore of the North Saskatchewan River to two kilometres beyond the F.E. Holiday Water Treatment Plant, heading east. You can also see where the North Saskatchewan and Battle Rivers converge along the trail. Trails are groomed in winter for cross country skiing and mowed in the summer for walking. services.name: Tennis courts
services.desc: One of the best in Saskatchewan, Beaver Lions Baseball Stadium has seating for 1,000 spectators and is a full senior baseball diamond complete with lights, grass infield, electronic scoreboard, concession, and an irrigated outfield. It is the home of the North Battleford Beavers Intermediate, Junior, and Midget baseball teams. In the fall, the Stadium is converted to a full-size football field that is used by the North Battleford Comprehensive High School Vikings as well as the local touch football teams. services.name: Swimming Lessons
services.desc: Our swimming lessons are designed to teach individuals of all ages and abilities the necessary skills to be safe and confident in the water. Our certified instructors use a progressive, learn-to-swim curriculum that is designed to build on the skills learned in each lesson. Programs are divided into levels, ranging from beginner to advanced. Each level focuses on specific skills such as floating, gliding, and stroke development. Our instructors will work with you to determine the appropriate level for your needs.
